prompt: What was David Fincher's most recently released feature film when Britney Spears' first feature film was released in the U.S.?
answer: Britney Spears’s first feature film, **_Crossroads_**, was released in the U.S. on **February 15, 2002**. At that time, David Fincher’s most recently released feature film was **_Fight Club_ (1999)**; his next film, **_Panic Room_**, opened in March 2002.
